extension.summary: On-demand Usenet: search indexers, press play
extension.description:
Search your Newznab indexers from Kodi, pick a release, and nzbkodi downloads it over NNTP, verifies PAR2, unpacks, and plays it — keeping the file in your download folder. Downloads survive navigation: walk away and come back via the Downloads menu.
Requires the nzbkodi-engine binary on PATH (NixOS: services configuration on Face), a Usenet server, and indexer API keys.
extension.news: First working version: search, movies, TV episodes, downloads menu, resume.
